completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as PRs driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor); each implementation phase lands through yeet and P3 must close mergeable.

phases.name: Bootstrap + Hardening
phases.exit: Live capability facts and package placement confirmed; verified repair registry and base-prefix fidelity pass locally; ROBOT remains host-gated. Evidence: history/2026-07-11-p0-hardening.md.

phases.name: Toolkit Definition
phases.exit: Curated schemas and thin handlers are real-engine tested; stateless CAS rejects stale writes recoverably; budgets and typed errors are server-enforced without a session repository or silent cache. Evidence: history/2026-07-11-p1-toolkit.md.

phases.name: Transport + Safety
phases.exit: Authenticated loopback /mcp passes a real client initialize/list/call proof for capability-metadata plus bounded sparql-query, and every enabled mutation is gated, attributed, and budgeted.

phases.name: Harden + Close
phases.exit: 1k/10k/100k benchmarks, tool docs, real-stack acceptance, reflection, and packet evidence are complete; Yeet reports the PR work mergeable.

stopConditions: Required source files are missing, materially contradictory, or decision-invalidating drift is found.
V1 requires a stateful session repository, second transport, OWL 2 DL reasoning, broad tool expansion, or another named non-goal.
Actor identity cannot be derived meaningfully at the authenticated boundary before attribution wiring begins.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval.
A required real-engine, live-client, CAS-conflict, or ROBOT proof cannot be produced.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
mission: Expose the ontology workbench to agents through a curated, task-oriented MCP toolkit on the professional-desktop sidecar: stateless over saved Turtle files, CAS-safe, authenticated, gated, attributed, budgeted, and proven against the real ontology engine stack.
